name: dsh-endnote
description: EndNote library integration for the DeepSeek Harness: add papers with their open-access PDFs, manage attachments and groups, de-duplicate, and refresh the search index. Registers 2 skills and 7 native tools over one shared Python implementation.

scripts.vendor: python tools/normalize_bootstrap.py && python tools/vendor_scripts.py && python tools/vendor_skills.py

_comment_peerDependencies: Both peers are genuinely optional: lib/index.js falls back to a local defineTool and to a Standard Schema-compatible Config when they cannot be resolved (the normal case for a `link:` install, where Node resolves the real path and never sees the profile's node_modules).
